items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1958-11-14
items.q: Mr. Voorhees used to work by Wuerlein.

ctx.x: Well where's he got it though now?
From the Wuerlein. Mr. Voorhees used to work by Wuerlein. They had it there on the exhibition. He used to run that. So it was like a company, $40 something. $40 something actually.
Because I used to see them, I used to see the BAME systems in New York in 1930 were $10 metal metal.
